purpose: Determine whether short natural Joel originals can be distinguished from the owner-identified Stian hard negative and two ordinary controls after Greg admission, while separating shared-thread matched-Dharma evidence from an independent TAFKA sensitivity stratum.

prefix_cleanliness.note: Full-source heuristic flags do not automatically disqualify a source when the exact evaluated 50-word prefix is clean. The benchmark evaluates only the exact prefix and records both source-level and prefix-level flags.

matched_dharma.profile_rule: For each Joel held-out document, Joel's profile is the other three exact-50 matched Joel originals. Control profiles are fixed three-document exact-50 profiles selected from current candidate queues.
matched_dharma.source_limit: Target holdouts are shared-thread by design because the current archive has insufficient fully nonoverlap Joel material.

independent_tafka.profile_rule: Use three fixed TAFKA exact-50 Joel profile documents and two independent TAFKA exact-50 Joel holdouts against the same Dharma control profiles.
independent_tafka.source_limit: Platform/register transfer confounds this stratum; report separately and never average with matched Dharma.

interpretation.primary_question: Does Stian remain the dominant short-text confound after adding Greg, and is Joel uniquely top-ranked on enough natural originals to support any target-specific retention interpretation?
interpretation.completion_rule: Whether separability is good or poor, freeze the result. Strong separation supports only provisional target-verification use for this named condition; poor separation disconfirms exact-50 unique-Joel attribution for this condition. Neither result authorizes a universal threshold.
